title: Zang International with Lynette Zang: OCC Derivatives Chart Change: Zang Questions Hidden
description:
Original video author: Zang International with Lynette Zang. Independent recap and commentary; no endorsement implied. The OCC derivatives chart change raises questions about bank risk in this recap of Zang International with Lynette Zang. We cover her comparison of Q1 and Q2 chart scales, then her statement that bilateral netting reduced gross current credit exposure by 90.5%. Next come her concerns about counterparties, collateral, liquidity and banking access, followed by her distinction between ownership and financial claims, purchasing-power warning and promotion of physical gold and silver consultations.

For entertainment and informational purposes only. This is not financial, legal, medical, or other professional advice. Consult a qualified professional about your circumstances. We are not responsible for decisions or results based on this video.

hook: Lynette Zang alleges an OCC chart change hides bank risk—but that is not an established finding.
